```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  playwright-e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Update port for e2e tests
        run: sed -i 's/"port": 5000/"port": 3456/' website/serve.json

      - name: Run Playwright e2e tests
        run: yarn test:e2e --browser=chromium --browser=firefox

  webdriverio-ie11:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Configure Sauce Labs credentials
        run: echo "SAUCE_USERNAME=${{ secrets.SAUCE_USERNAME }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        run: echo "SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY=${{ secrets.SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run WebdriverIO IE11 tests
        run: yarn test:e2e --browser=sauce --browserName=internet explorer --browserVersion=11
```
